title: BrightBlog
description: BrightBlog is a simple and visually appealing blog webpage that allows users to create posts with titles, descriptions, and images. Users can also engage with posts through a commenting feature.

features.name: Create Blog Posts
features.description: Users can create blog posts by adding a title, description, and uploading images.

features.name: Image Upload
features.description: Users can upload images to include in their blog posts without restrictions on file size, format, or resolution.

features.name: Commenting System
features.description: Users can leave comments on blog posts to engage with the content.

features.name: Bright and Beautiful Design
features.description: The webpage will feature a visually appealing and bright design to enhance user experience.

constraints: No user authentication or roles are required.
No specific technologies or frameworks are mandated.
target_users: General users who want to create and interact with blog content.
data_requirements: Each blog post should store a title, description, and associated images. Comments should be linked to their respective blog posts.
